name: canvas-design
tagline_zh: 想要海报、艺术图或设计稿？一句话，它用设计哲学生成原创视觉，不抄大师，却让空白画布秒变惊艳作品。
tagline_en: One sentence to a poster, art, or design. It applies design philosophy to craft original visuals—no copying, just.
desc_en: Create beautiful visual art in .png and .pdf documents using design philosophy. You should use this skill when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static piece. Create original visual designs, never copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.
why_zh: 它把设计原则内化为生成逻辑，而非模板堆砌；从构图到配色自动权衡，原创性有保障，比同类更懂审美。
why_en: It bakes design principles into generation logic, not templates—auto-balancing layout and color for original, tasteful results.
